value.rationale: The natural full rank-six circular-automaton class has a complete exact 648-cell shortest-duration/shortest-control-word distribution. Control-protocol multiplicity distinguishes automata with identical length, with 388869 uniquely optimal classes and a unique maximum of 110592 words at length 30 despite the longest length-36 class having only eight. The exact finite invariant is motivated by reset-language enumeration and redundancy in synchronization, independent of the already-known threshold marginal.
